description: This file contains shell functions and procedures related to the platform upgrade process for a Linux-based embedded device, specifically for the bcm27xx architecture. It includes functions for checking images, performing upgrades, setting root partition UUIDs, copying configuration files, and restoring backups, relying on sourced external functions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and partition layout of an image before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process, writing image data to device partitions.

methods.name: bcm27xx_set_root_part
methods.description: Sets the root partition UUID in the boot configuration.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from backup to the device, updating root partition settings.

methods.name: platform_restore_backup
methods.description: Restores a backup archive to the device's root filesystem.
